item.title: Find Hidden Red Flags in Job Descriptions 🚨 • Review 3 job descriptions in your field. • Look for vague terms like 'fast-paced' or 'wear many hats'. • Identify phrases suggesting unpaid overtime or unclear roles. • Check for unrealistic qualification requirements. • Note any lack of company culture or values mentioned. What red flags have you noticed in job descriptions you've read today? #jobsearch #careeradvice #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
